limitations: Station circulation and all street access are generic nominal layouts, not verified entrances.
India Gate and Lahori Gate front/back orientation is symmetric about the OSM footprint long axis.
Lotus petal rotation and shell curvature are nominal; pools and grounds omitted without captured site geometry.
Reference images are not texture licences. Only original generated geometry and materials are distributed.
Rashtrapati Bhavan and Supreme Court use source building outlines including courtyard holes for 2D; 3D architecture and interior wing layout are approximate, not surveyed reconstruction.

Hanuman statue uses a rounded published directory point; no verified OSM statue footprint was found. Width 14 m, depth 12 m, heading, pose and sculptural details are nominal. 108 ft converted to rounded nominal 32.92 m.
New models are original procedural bpy geometry, generated locally with Blender Python 5.0.1. No paid, downloaded third-party or photo-textured model is included.
This batch adds 17 places: eight Delhi malls, National Zoological Park and eight monuments/religious sites. Place membership is curated, not an exhaustive Delhi attraction inventory.

Vegas Dwarka and Pacific Tagore Garden sources map retail/commercial land parcels, not surveyed building footprints. They and Delhi Zoo use open site outlines; their actual city context is retained and no internal building, entrance, habitat or animal geometry is invented.

Select CITYWALK and DLF Avenue each have two source polygon parts. Ambience Vasant Kunj retains its courtyard in both geographic data and the mall model. Retail facade details, signage placement and heights remain nominal.

Humayun Tomb, Safdarjung Tomb and Raj Ghat source OSM Wikidata tags point to people, not the places. Use exact source names/tags and published place references; conflicts are retained in processed provenance. Humayun outline height=3 is not a complete mausoleum height.

Purana Qila scope is Bara Darwaza only. Jantar Mantar scope is Samrat Yantra only. Agrasen ki Baoli is an explicitly labelled raised cutaway of a real sunken well; display height, depth, steps and arcades are nominal.
Footprint-derived mall and site model XY coordinates pass through projection.ts during the data build. No direct latitude/longitude interpretation is added to Blender or frontend model code.
Akshardham’s mapped footprint is smaller than its officially published plan dimensions; keep the OSM outline and log the mismatch instead of expanding it without surveyed geometry.
